instruction: Remove the bold formatting from the title text

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing bold formatting from the title 'The History of Art'. Evaluator checks if the title text (shape 0 on slide 0) is NOT bold. Verified current state: title is currently bold, so the agent must remove bold formatting.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical logical error in metric function: The metric returns 1.0 if text IS bold and 0.0 if text is NOT bold, which is inverted from the expected behavior
The metric function ignores the 'expected' parameter entirely and just returns '1.0 if result else 0.0'

With expected=false (text should NOT be bold), the current logic would: (1) Return 1.0 (success) if bold formatting is still present, (2) Return 0.0 (failure) if bold formatting was successfully removed
This means the evaluator will PASS when the agent fails to remove bold, and FAIL when the agent successfully removes bold - completely backwards
The getter logic is correct (checks if text is bold), and postconfig is appropriate (saves the file), but the metric comparison logic is fundamentally broken
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Fix the metric function to compare result against expected: 'return 1.0 if result == expected else 0.0'
This will make the logic correct: if result=False (not bold) and expected=False -> returns 1.0 (success), if result=True (bold) and expected=False -> returns 0.0 (failure)
